name: Vital-Hof Wanishof
beschreibung: The Vital-Hof Wanishof is situated in the idyllic Tyrolean valley basin of Thiersee, surrounded by lush meadows and mountains. This historic farmhouse has been lovingly converted into a holiday residence that seamlessly blends rustic warmth with modern amenities. Guests can unwind in the peaceful alpine surroundings and take advantage of the numerous hiking trails and excursion destinations nearby.
